title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11255__PART_4_)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard (Part 3) prescribes a method for determination of flow rate of a gas stream in confined spaces, like stacks and duct. 1.1.1 Methods for determination of stack gas velocity, temperature, static and differential pressure, moisture content and molecular weight of stack gases necessitates measurement of these parameters for flow rate determination. 1.1.2 Gas flow in a large industrial stack or ducts may be steady and well mixed across the diameter of the stack, in such case any sample taken at any time and from any place in the stack will be representative. But for most such stacks the velocity and concentration in stack vary from point to point and time-to-time therefore many separate measurement must be made and averaged for determination of flow rate.
